resources.string: Removes ads, sponsored apps, and promoted recommendations from the Google Play Store
All optional filters are disabled by default. Regular sponsored-ad filtering remains active.
Removes large LiveOps cards such as promoted apps, games and events.
Removes the Play Points reminder card from the account menu.
Removes the Play Protect account entry and the internal warning card from Manage apps & device.
Removes the notifications row from the account menu.
Forces the unread count to zero when Play Store shows a stale +1 badge.
Removes the Play Pass entry from the account menu.
Removes the Library entry from the account menu.
Removes the Help & feedback entry from the account menu.
Removes the Google Play personalization entry from the account menu.
Removes the experimental features entry from the account menu.
Removes the payments and subscriptions entry from the account menu.
Removes the pre-registration games section from the Games tab.
Removes “Sync apps to devices” from Manage apps & device.
Removes “Ratings & reviews” from Manage apps & device.
Removes “Your contributions” from Manage apps & device.
Removes this item from the bottom navigation while keeping Search available.
Opens the selected visible tab when Play Store starts. “Keep Play Store choice” leaves its normal behavior unchanged.
Restart Google Play Store after changing filters so cached screens are rebuilt.
